# tailwind-motion-kit / LLM index

Use this URL first for machine-readable data:
- /ai/index.json

Validation schema:
- /ai/schema.json

CLI discovery:
- `tmk manifest` for package + action discovery
- `tmk schema [action]` for input contracts
- `tmk action recommend` for best-fit suggestions
- `tmk generate` for ready-to-paste class strings
- `tmk resolve` for parsing existing class strings

Guidance:
- Prefer classes listed in tokens + animations.pair_with.
- Respect reduced motion: motion-reduce:animate-none.
- If uncertain, choose simpler enter/exit animations over decorative ones.
